James Talarico

Democratic candidate for U.S. Senator, Texas · Open seat

State representative; former middle school teacher

In his fourth term in the Texas House representing parts of North Austin. Previously taught at Rhodes Middle School in San Antonio ISD. Won the Democratic nomination with 52.4% over U.S. Rep. Jasmine Crockett.

Where Talarico stands

Gas tax
Supports suspending the federal gas tax and ending the Iran war to lower fuel costs.
Data centers
Wants data centers to pay their own infrastructure costs, end their tax breaks, and let communities decide where they go.
Iran and war powers
Will vote for a war powers resolution to end the war and restore Senate oversight.
Border wall in Big Bend
Opposes a wall through Big Bend; proposes more agents, judges, surveillance technology, and barriers where needed.
Gender care for minors
Does not support gender surgery for minors; criticizes what he calls political attacks on children.
Marijuana and hemp
Supports legal, regulated adult marijuana with taxes funding public safety and health programs.
Tariffs
Wants them repealed, saying they raise family costs and cost jobs.

Background

  • Texas House of Representatives, fourth term (North Austin)
  • Teacher, Rhodes Middle School (San Antonio ISD)
  • Worked at education nonprofit Reasoning Mind
